title: Night Shift (demo)
style: A frozen frame from a security camera: wide-angle, slightly fisheye, flat fluorescent light, low-resolution, a little noise and compression, a timestamp-free clean image, empty and quiet, an American office tower at night.
negative: text, watermark, timestamp, people looking at the camera, cartoon, illustration, gore, weapons

dee.name: Dee
dee.design: A woman in her late fifties, Bronx accent with a worn, low alto, dry and unhurried. Speaks quietly and flatly, slight humor underneath. Recorded close and slightly dry, with faint room tone.

terrell.name: Terrell
terrell.design: A young man of twenty-four, Brooklyn, easy and a little too quick, finishing other people's sentences.

ambience.control-room: The hum of a windowless control room at night: a wall of monitors, a ventilation fan, a distant elevator, nothing else.
ambience.morning: A lobby at dawn: a revolving door turning once, the street far away, a coffee machine ticking.

sfx.radio-squelch: A short handheld radio squelch and click, a man's hand keying it.
sfx.pencil: A pencil writing on paper, a few short strokes.

states.normal: The lobby desk, the turnstiles and the revolving door, all empty, the long bench by the window.
The airlock between Madison Avenue and the lobby, one bench-like ledge, cold light from the street.
The rollup door, the dock office window and a trash compactor under a single caged bulb.
A fire door on a concrete landing with a painted number 31, closed.
states.wedge: The same fire door on the 31st floor landing held open a hand's width by a small orange rubber wedge.

states.normal: Four elevator cars, a call panel and a plant, the floor shining.
A long carpeted corridor and a janitor's closet door at the far end.

scenes.title: Radio check

lines.speaker: dee
lines.text: Mm. You're a minute late. Sit.

scenes.log: Radio check with D. Reyes. Wall: nine tiles.

choices.log: Answered the check, a minute late.
Camera 4: the 31st floor stairwell door is not closed.

scenes.title: The wall

lines.speaker: dee
lines.text: Nothing happens at two o'clock. That's why we're here.

lines.speaker: terrell
lines.text: Camera four, the door. Is that, like, normal?

scenes.log: 02:10. Wall quiet. Camera 4 stairwell door, 31st floor.

choices.log: Pointed out camera 4: the door, held open.
Called the supervisor's night line: wedge, stairwell C, 31.

choices.say: Keep your eyes on the lobby
choices.log: Stayed on the wall. Lobby clear.

lines.speaker: dee
lines.text: Write what you saw. Not what you think about what you saw.

choices.log: Dee read the log in pencil.

lines.speaker: dee
lines.text: That's noted. Go home. Eat something.
